asr.full_text: I wanted to do a quick step-by-step guide tutorial video about how to create a great trading bot on bullrun bot because I get a lot of comments on here and on telegram about how exactly do you set up a bot like in five steps so I created a new account for you for this for the purposes of this video I input $100 on Arbitrum because Brambo did a recent update where they only run a grid trading boats on GMX on Arbitrum and I think they are about to add avalanche as well so let's let's get into it the first thing you do is you click on wallets you click on import new wallet because that's the one that is going to be controlling the bot with swaps etc you name it whatever you want for example boorun bot test or what you want then you input your private key which is a 64 letter number and letters you find it when you click on the top right hand corner on your metamask pop-up then you click on the wallet you want to use you click on account details export private key as you can see in this tutorial the images and you copy your 64 letter private key and paste it here then you click Save and you have your wallet as you can see I did a test demo wallet GMEX Arbitrum John now you click on bot settings because you want to set a bot using your wallet so you choose the wallet you want to use that's the one that you just imported you select grid trading that's the only options and arbitrum that's also the only option then you can choose between three stable coins that's how much dollars you are going to spend or the bot is going to spend then the token you want to trade I would recommend you you trade CRP Matic or Eve but Eve is the least volatile and the least profitable in my experience then I will input about zero point seven to one percent profit this is the best profit percentage that ever worked for me the number of orders should be In the means of having at least $20 per order, but I would recommend at least 50 so with $500 you would put 10 orders and Then 10% rate cover up to 30% rate cover to generate some profits I had a boat running for you guys I selected stablecoin die slash wrapped Eve I only ran run for one day 24 hours it completed it completed three cycles it stopped at the moment as you can see in the new dashboard here. I have one stop in bots. The all-time profit was 0.64 dollars which is 0.64% in one day so as you can see I have stopped for 24 hours so my 24-hour performance is zero. In one day, give or take 1% profit is pretty good. I think it's absolutely amazing but it depends on market volatility and as you can see it was a huge pump when I ran it. So grid bots make the most money on volatile markets. And this was just a quick video about how to set up a grid bot in literally three minutes you can set up the grid board with me uh for the length of the video is going to be three to four minutes so it's super easy you select the arbitrum chain not the binance smart chain not the polygon chain you need the arbitrum chain which is ethereum but much much more cheaper and faster also it's unsusorable but that's a topic for another video um and yeah you just put 500 dollars 100 dollars whatever you want into the stable coins on ETH and then on Arbitrum and then you put some Ethereum for the fees. You can get the cheapest Arbitrum ETH on OKEx and KuCoin but I think Binance also supports Arbitrum I'm not sure about it because I I don't use them. So yeah that was all for this video, I hope some of you guys find it helpful. Maybe you are wondering on how to do it fast, or what exactly you need. So top off your wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stable coins, and you can run your own bot within 5 minutes.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an automated crypto-trading bot while claiming it can produce 210 dollars per day and instructing viewers to fund a wallet with Arbitrum ETH and stablecoins. It also directs viewers to enter a MetaMask private key for a wallet described as controlling swaps, linking sensitive credential disclosure and asset-funded participation to the promoted activity. The speaker reports only a 0.64-dollar one-day result and notes that performance depends on market volatility, so guaranteed returns, actual losses, and later outcomes are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker's central demonstration connects configuring and funding a trading bot with claimed profit. The same walkthrough expressly instructs viewers to paste an existing wallet private key into the bot's import form, separately supporting an account-access or sensitive-data cue. The displayed performance and speaker's account do not verify actual returns.
